label: silent-delivery-and-replay
query: A supervisor amendment was marked delivered but never appeared in the worker context, then the same message was injected again after it had already been consumed.
hypothesis: Dense retrieval should join silent loss and duplicate replay even when exact delivery-state terms differ.

label: poll-tick-redelivery-storm
query: One pending worker message generated thousands of misleading delivered and wake-deferred log lines on every poll tick without a durable state transition.
hypothesis: Template-normalized log evidence should retrieve the historical redelivery storm and its fix task.

label: instruction-prefix-drift
query: Worker startup guidance used an obsolete MCP tool prefix or told an already registered worker to start another session.
hypothesis: Semantic retrieval should link differently worded harness-guidance drift observations.

label: merge-close-race
query: A worker claimed completion and attempted to close before the factory branch was merged, then discovered binding supervisor amendments during the rejection handshake.
hypothesis: Dense retrieval should connect premature close, merge-required, and crossed-message evidence.

label: parallel-migration-collision
query: Parallel implementation lanes independently selected the same database migration number because each derived the next identifier from a stale branch tip.
hypothesis: Semantic retrieval should find the collision family without requiring the exact migration IDs.

label: missed-harness-mirror
query: A built-in skill or agent change updated the Claude copy but forgot the corresponding Codex and Grok mirrors.
hypothesis: Dense retrieval should associate missed surfaces across differently named harness copies.

label: workspace-contract-conflict
query: Task instructions prescribed a large artifact path that the factory workspace policy rejected, requiring a sanctioned durable fallback without retrying the denied path.
hypothesis: Hybrid retrieval should connect policy text, denials, and recovery decisions.

label: withdrawn-missing-code-path-claim
query: An investigation claimed there was no reconciliation code path, but later source inspection proved the mechanism existed and the original evidence did not test it.
hypothesis: Dense retrieval should surface the correction and distinguish it from repetitions of the withdrawn claim.
